title: Willie Parker's band and the Eureka
summary: He names members of Willie Parker's band and how Willie Wilson later reorganized the Eureka band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well that Willie Parker's band then, who was in that? We were telling them about that, but I don't think we got to do something.

Yes, one of the guys that came on, who had such a big band, some of them I can't even call the names. I know, can think of a trumpet player, some of them. Wood and Jill, that's Jill Nichols, that's his right name. Willie Webber, followed by the name of Willie Wilson, who took the band over and reorganized the Eureka band. But Willie Parker, the first one, had the Eureka band in charge.
Well that sounds like the Eureka band, what's your name? Willie Webber and Willie Wilson. Yeah. Do you know Willie Wilson's brother? Yeah, just to play baritone.

Johnny. Yeah, I know him. Well all those fellas I used to go sit down and listen at the rehearsals when they had it, at Willie Parker's house. I tried to think of this old fella who played trombone. I used to get a kick out of it man, he's a low shot fella. Buddy something. He's got some relation, still living playing music in the way for the end. Buddy, is that Buddy from Al Jills? No, no, this old man is from the Ron Wood, Ron Jill Nichols neighborhood. I can't think of this guy's name.
